scope: Path-role placeholders are not literal executable paths. Raw hashes remain original; curation is disclosed separately.

roles.$INITIAL_SOURCE_ROOT: Frozen 1,786-file source archive used for the first complete workspace run.
roles.$INITIAL_CHECK_LOGS: Raw logs and generated outputs of that first workspace run.
roles.$REPAIRED_TEX_BUILD: Accepted warning-free three-pass manuscript build after the declared two-file formatting delta.
roles.$PRIOR_CPP_BUILD: Previous C++ compilation directory; the current batch reused these binaries.
roles.$TEX_SETUP_ATTEMPT_1: First post-repair setup attempt, failed for missing pdflatex format.
roles.$TEX_SETUP_ATTEMPT_2: Second post-repair setup attempt, failed at kpathsea database lookup.
roles.$FOUR_CUT_TEMP: Ephemeral bounded four-cut kernel execution directory.
roles.$ELAN_BIN: Lean executable directory used by the build driver.
roles.$LOCAL_TEXMF_VAR: Local generated TeX format and font-map root.
